inputs.description: A list of `Tensor` objects, each with same shape and type.

shape.description: Expected shape of elements of `inputs` (optional). Also controls the output shape of this op, which may affect type inference in other ops. A value of `None` means "infer the input shape from the shapes in `inputs`".

tensor_dtype.description: Expected data type of `inputs` (optional). A value of `None` means "infer the input dtype from `inputs[0]`".

output.description: A `Tensor` of same shape and type as the elements of `inputs`.
